regularization_selection_evidence: outputs/regularization_selection.json; selected on real_row_0/interpolation/seed0 without test labels
selection_rule: validation RMSE within 1.05x of best prefers lower finite-difference roughness; frozen before final test reporting

protocols.gap: central contiguous 10% held out as final test; remaining points randomized 85/15 train/validation

geometry: Arc length and radial target use the complete measured (X,Z) curve only as declared transductive geometry; every target scaler uses train indices only.
budget_rationale: 750 updates is frozen after timing the original 250-update runs. It is below the 5000-update cap to make the real six-curve, two-protocol, five-model, three-seed matrix feasible.
real_curve_selection: predeclared source rows 0,900,1800,2700,3600,4500,5400,6300; first six are the fixed formal real set
